facts.summary: Interim analysis showed insufficient efficacy, program terminated · Phase 2 · FG-3246 in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Following a pre-specified interim analysis of the ongoing Phase 2 study of FG-3246 in mCRPC, the Company decided to close enrollment in the study and discontinue development of the program.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Preliminary efficacy results at the interim analysis did not meet the threshold required to support continued development.
evidence.program_discontinued: Decision to discontinue development of FG-3246 and FG-3180 following insufficient efficacy at the pre-specified Phase 2 interim analysis in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC)
